sources.title: Fast, Tiny, Local Image Generation: Qwen-Image-2512
sources.snippet: Quantized GGUF and Humming (vLLM-Omni) builds of Qwen-Image-2512. Around 8-9 seconds per 1024x1024 image on high-end GPUs, low-VRAM options with CPU offload, and curated quality comparisons.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2512 Quantization: Image Comparison Explorer
sources.snippet: 24 refined prompts, each generated by BF16 and six quantizations of Qwen-Image-2512, in two families: GGUF and Humming. Compare any two variants with a reveal slider, zoom both at once, and read each family's own curator notes.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2512 · Models
sources.snippet: Enhanced Huamn Realism Qwen-Image-2512 significantly reduces the "AI-generated" look and substantially enhances overall image realism, especially for human subjects. Finer Natural Detail Qwen-Image-2512 delivers notably more detailed rendering of landscapes, animal fur, and other natural elements.
